title: Synthetic inspection queue pressure
provenance_detail: Original synthetic operational-context note authored for ShopfloorPilot; it is not a factory throughput benchmark or maintenance manual excerpt.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: An increased QC queue depth after a priority order is registered is operational load evidence, not by itself evidence of an equipment fault. Compare arrivals, completions, and current availability before deciding whether maintenance guidance is relevant.
observable_symptoms: QC queue depth increased after a priority order
suggested_checks: Compare recent order arrivals with inspection completions.
Check the current public availability of the inspection resource.
Keep scheduling congestion separate from maintenance hypotheses.
limitations: The queue value is synthetic and does not establish capacity, service-time, or equipment-health limits.
